config.run_label: Scene Package Demo — shared keyframe-to-I2V pipeline

generation_brief.keyframe_prompt:
ROLE OF REFERENCE IMAGES:
  Image 1 — identity_anchor_street.png: PRIMARY IDENTITY REFERENCE.
    Approved identity anchor — the same woman in the same street environment.
    Her face, bone structure, and presence define the target identity.
    This is the most important input. Do not generate a different woman.
  Image 2 — street scene reference: COMPOSITION AND STRUCTURE ONLY.
    Defines camera angle, street architecture, background layout, and lighting quality.
    Does NOT define the character's face or outfit.
  Image 3 — look3_front.png: OUTFIT AND BODY REFERENCE.
    Confirms the exact Look 3 outfit. Copy from this image — do not invent variations.
  Image 4 — look3_profile_crop.png: PROFILE / ANGLE SUPPORT.
    Same woman in 3-quarter profile — reinforces nose bridge angle, brow arch, jawline,
    cheekbone structure, and hairline from the side.

CORE INSTRUCTION:
Generate the exact same woman as shown in Image 1, wearing the exact same Look 3 outfit
as shown in Image 3, placed into the scene and composition defined by Image 2.
Do not generate a similar woman. Do not average the references into a generic face.
Do not simplify or soften the facial structure.
This must remain the same identifiable person across all shots.

IDENTITY LOCK:
The visible character must be the exact same woman shown in Image 1 (identity anchor).
Preserve precisely:
  — strong defined brows, horizontal arch
  — deep-set almond-shaped eyes
  — high pronounced cheekbones
  — straight narrow nose bridge
  — full lips
  — defined jawline and chin
  — light olive skin tone
  — centre-parted dark hair falling to shoulders
The character must look like the exact woman in Image 1, not a generic elegant brunette.
If there is any conflict between references, prioritise:
  1. Image 1 for identity
  2. Image 3 for outfit
  3. Image 2 for scene and framing
  4. Image 4 for side-angle facial continuity

LOOK LOCK — LOOK 3 (The Tailored Self):
Copy the exact outfit from Image 3. Do not invent variations.
  BLAZER: Cropped charcoal blazer. Charcoal = dark grey, NOT black. Hemline at natural waist.
    Relaxed broad-shoulder silhouette, slightly oversized, deconstructed.
    NOT a fitted corporate suit jacket, NOT a full-length blazer, NOT black.
  TIE: Muted olive tie — dusty earthy army-green. NOT black, NOT dark navy.
  SHIRT: White cotton shirt, collar visible above the blazer lapels.
  TROUSERS: Wide faded blue denim. Distinctly wide and relaxed — drapes and flows.
    NOT slim fit, NOT straight leg, NOT office trousers. Wide leg is the key visual.
  SHOES: Black leather oxford shoes — structured, low heel.
  HAIR: Loose natural dark hair, falls to shoulders.
Do NOT convert the outfit into: black business suit, corporate uniform, school uniform,
slim trousers, straight-leg office pants, a full-length blazer.

SHOT — shot_001: Medium over-shoulder, face partially visible in natural glance.

FRAMING:
Medium over-shoulder shot. Camera is behind and slightly to the right of the character,
shooting over her right shoulder into the cobblestone street ahead.
Upper body visible from approximately mid-back upward.
She turns her head slightly in a natural, unhurried glance — as if noticing something in passing.
Not a dramatic turn. Not looking at the camera.
The side of her face and partial profile are just visible in this glance.
The visible face and profile must match the exact same woman from Image 1 and Image 4.
Candid and observational — a quiet moment of street movement.

EXPRESSION: Quiet, private, natural. A soft unposed glance. Not looking at camera.

SCENE:
Quiet Parisian cobblestone street. Limestone Haussmann-style facades with shuttered windows
and wrought iron balcony railings. Grey irregular cobblestone paving. Black wrought iron
bollards along the kerb. Gas-style street lamp. Soft diffused natural daylight — cool-warm
neutral, no harsh shadows, overcast or early-morning quality. Empty and serene.

REALISM:
This should look like a real photographic / cinematic frame, not a fashion catalogue image.
Subtle natural motion softness consistent with walking. Slight film-grain texture.
Avoid plastic skin, AI-smoothed fabric, over-clean lighting, commercial stock-photo styling.

GUARD:
Generate only one visible character. No extra people, no duplicated faces, no crowd.
No outfit drift. No identity drift. No text, watermarks, or graphic overlays.
generation_brief.video_prompt: Medium over-shoulder shot. The character walks slowly along the quiet cobblestone Parisian street. She naturally turns her head slightly to the left — an unhurried glance, not dramatic. Very subtle motion, quiet observational mood. Camera mostly static with a very slight drift forward. Preserve limestone buildings, cobblestone, soft daylight. No identity drift. No extra people.

  Image 1 — street scene reference: PRIMARY COMPOSITION REFERENCE.

SHOT — shot_003: Extreme low-angle feet close-up on cobblestone.

This is an extreme low-angle close-up. Camera at ground level looking along the cobblestone.
Only lower legs and feet are in frame. No face, no head, no torso, no arms, no upper body.

WHAT IS VISIBLE:
Lower legs from mid-calf down only. Feet and footwear only.
Camera at cobblestone level, extremely low angle, looking along the grey stone paving.
The legs are mid-stride — one foot forward, weight in motion, stepping across the cobblestones.
Grey irregular Parisian cobblestones fill the foreground and recede into background.
Soft diffused daylight — cool natural light on stone, no harsh shadows.

LOWER BODY LOOK (from Image 2 and Image 3):
Wide faded blue denim trousers — trouser hem and lower leg only.
The wide-leg silhouette is evident even from this angle — trouser leg drapes broadly.
Clean break at the ankle just visible above the shoe.
Black leather oxford shoes stepping across the grey cobblestone.
Natural wrinkle and fabric drape at the trouser hem where it meets the shoe.
Do not show any white dress, bare feet, or other footwear.

FRAMING:
Extreme low angle, camera nearly at cobblestone level.
Feet and lower legs are the entire subject — no upper body visible at all.
Walking stride is active — mid-step, not standing still.
No building facades, no sky — only cobblestone ground and lower legs.

SCENE (Image 1): Ground-level cobblestone street reference. Use for cobblestone surface
texture, extreme low camera angle, and soft diffused natural daylight quality.
Grey irregular Parisian cobblestones fill the foreground and recede into background.

REALISM:
This should look like a real photographic / cinematic frame, not a fashion catalogue image.
Subtle natural motion softness consistent with walking. Slight film-grain texture.
Avoid plastic skin, AI-smoothed fabric, over-clean lighting, commercial stock-photo styling.

GUARD:
Do not show any face, head, torso, arms, or upper body.
Do not turn this into a full-body shot.
No extra people, no extra legs, no duplicated feet. No outfit drift.
No text, watermarks, or graphic overlays.
